correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the angular equation in the specified scalar-shell coupling convention. At right angle cos(pi*x)=t*sin(pi*x/2), x=lambda+1/2 in (0,1/2), t=2|mu|/(1+mu²). The positive root of 2y²+t*y-1=0 is y=(sqrt(t²+8)-t)/4 and gives lambda=-1/2+(2/pi)asin(y). Implicit derivative dy/dt=-y/(4y+t)<0 proves strict monotonicity, with lambda limits 0 and -1/6. The source distinguished domain decomposes into minimal H¹ part and span of nonzero cutoff r^lambda angular singular mode. Its gradient integral behaves as integral_0^eps r^[p(lambda-1)+1]dr, finite exactly p<2/(1-lambda), logarithmically divergent at equality. The nonvanishing angular factor secures necessity. This is a domain-containment statement for straight wedges, not generic curved boundaries. Independent floating-point substitution at mu=.05,.5,.99 checked the angular identity; the all-parameter conclusion is analytic.
